us.judge_en: The compass places the US in Downtrend · Starved: price momentum is decelerating (z = -0.89) and the real mortgage-credit impulse is contracting at the same time (z = -0.55). Nominal prices are still rising 3.4% year-on-year, but on the full 50-year US cycle this is the weakest of the four cells, with a median forward-3-year gain of just 8.8% (n=62) versus 15-20% in the other three.
us.judge_zh: 羅盤把美國放在下行·斷炊：房價動能正在減速（z=-0.89），實質房貸信貸脈衝同時也在收縮（z=-0.55）。名目房價年增仍有3.4%，但放進美國完整50年週期來看，這是四個象限中最弱的一格，未來三年漲幅中位數僅8.8%（n=62），明顯低於其他三格的15%至20%。
us.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is on this quarter, triggered by the completions side — months-supply is loose (z = -1.84) even though homeowner vacancy itself is neutral (z = 0), meaning the excess sits in new construction still working through the pipeline rather than in existing empty homes.
us.warn_zh: 本季供給過剩警示為開，觸發點在完工端——月供給寬鬆（z=-1.84），儘管自住空置率本身持平（z=0），代表過剩集中在仍在興建管線中的新案，而非既有空屋。
us.card_val_en: Valuation is at its most expensive in the full 50-year record (z=−3.0) — price-to-income sits at the very top of its historical range.
us.card_val_zh: 估值處於整整 50 年紀錄中最貴的一端（z=−3.0）——房價對所得比落在歷史區間的最頂點。
us.card_pop_en: Population growth has turned negative (z = -0.87 on the absolute scale) — a reversal from the post-2020 immigration-driven surge, not just a slowdown relative to trend.
us.card_pop_zh: 人口成長轉為負值（絕對值尺度z=-0.87）——不只是相對趨勢走弱，而是從2020年後移民驅動的成長趨勢出現逆轉。
us.card_sup_en: Supply is loose near a historical extreme (z=−2.1) — months-supply of new homes is high across the full record, inventory building in the pipeline.
us.card_sup_zh: 供給寬鬆、逼近歷史極端（z=−2.1）——新屋月供給在整段紀錄中偏高，庫存正於管線中累積。
us.traj_en: The US moved from Fuelled through the 2020-22 pandemic boom into Draining as the Fed hiking cycle hit credit in 2022-23, dipped into Starved by late 2023, had a brief Draining rebound in mid-2024, and has sat in Starved since Q4 2024 — six straight quarters now.
us.traj_zh: 美國從2020年至2022年疫情熱潮期的有燃料，隨聯準會升息衝擊信貸轉入2022年至2023年的資金退，2023年底落入斷炊，2024年中曾短暫回到資金退，自2024年第4季起持續停留在斷炊，至今已連續六季。
us.xc_val_en: Ranked against the other 11 markets right now, the US is middling, not extreme: PTI of 12x ranks 5th, gross yield of 5.5% ranks 2nd, and the valuation composite comes out at +0.30 — barely on the cheap side of the world median. That's a sharp contrast with the self-history gauge above, which reads the US at its most expensive point in 50 years (z=-3.0): the same market looks stretched against its own past but only ordinary against the world.
us.xc_val_zh: 放進當下其他11個市場一起比較，美國的讀數其實並不極端：房價所得比12倍排名第5（中段），毛租金報酬率5.5%排名第2（相對強），估值綜合分數為+0.30，僅略偏世界中位數的便宜側。這與上方的自身歷史量表形成鮮明對比——那套量表把美國讀成50年紀錄中最貴的一端（z=-3.0）：同一個市場，相對自己的過去顯得緊繃，相對世界卻只是普通。
us.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is -1.3%, ranked 7th of 12 — the mortgage rate still runs ahead of the rental yield, so a levered US buyer is feeding the property every month rather than collecting income, betting the gap closes through price appreciation.
us.xc_carry_zh: 利差為-1.3%，在12個市場中排名第7——房貸利率仍高於租金報酬率，代表槓桿持有的美國買家每月都在倒貼、而不是收租金，賭的是房價後續上漲補回這個缺口。
us.risk_en: The mechanism: a Starved reading (falling momentum, tightening credit) combined with a live supply-glut flag — the exact pairing this backtest tested, frozen before any table was run. The number: quarters carrying it were followed by a 3-year nominal price loss {PREC_ABS}% of the time, against {PREC_ABS_OFF}% when the warning was off — an odds ratio of {OR_ABS}× — and landed in the US's own worst quartile of 50-year outcomes {PREC_REL}% of the time (vs {PREC_REL_OFF}% off, OR {OR_REL}×). What it means for a buyer: this is the strongest, most tested claim on this page — when this light is on, the odds of a paper loss within three years are meaningfully higher than at any other point in the US cycle.
us.risk_zh: 機制：斷炊讀數（動能下滑、信貸收緊）疊加正在亮燈的供給過剩警示——正是這套回測所檢驗、且在跑任何表格前就已凍結的組合。數字：帶有此組合的季度，其後三年出現名目虧損的比例為{PREC_ABS}%，警示關閉時僅{PREC_ABS_OFF}%——勝算比{OR_ABS}倍——落入美國自身50年紀錄最差四分之一的比例為{PREC_REL}%（警示關閉時為{PREC_REL_OFF}%，勝算比{OR_REL}倍）。對買家的意義：這是本頁測試最嚴謹、最站得住腳的一條結論——當這盞燈亮起，三年內出現帳面虧損的機率，明顯高於美國週期中的其他任何時刻。

tw.judge_en: Taiwan's compass currently reads downtrend / starved: price momentum (z=-1.742) and credit impulse (z=-1.273) are contracting together, and the -0.5% YoY price change confirms the market has actually turned down. Because Taiwan's usable history only runs back to 2001 and has been almost single-directional (mostly a bull run), treat this reading as a snapshot of the current state, not a forecast of what comes next.
tw.judge_zh: 台灣羅盤目前落在「下行·斷炊」象限：動能（z=-1.742）與信貸脈衝（z=-1.273）同步收縮，而現值年增率-0.5%也印證房價確實轉入下跌。由於台灣可用歷史僅自2001年起、且幾乎是單向多頭，這裡的讀數應理解為當下狀態的紀錄，而非對未來走勢的預測。
tw.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is ON for Taiwan, based on the low-electricity-usage vacancy proxy — a sizeable share of housing units show minimal electricity consumption, consistent with an elevated stock of unsold or unoccupied units.
tw.warn_zh: 台灣的供給過剩警示為「開啟」，依據為低用電量空屋率代理指標——相當比例的住宅單位用電量偏低，與未售或閒置存量偏高的狀況一致。
tw.card_val_en: Against Taiwan's own history the price-to-income ratio is mid-range (z≈0) — but that history is uniformly expensive: the ratio has sat near 9× for a decade. Note the series itself only starts in 2016, so this whole-history z is really a 2016–2026 comparison, not the fuller 2001–2026 span the compass otherwise covers. In absolute, cross-country terms Taiwan is among the least affordable markets anywhere; this gauge reads its own history, not that absolute.
tw.card_val_zh: 相對台灣自身歷史，房價所得比落在中段（z≈0）——但台灣的歷史本身就一路偏貴：此比值十年來都在 9 倍上下。須留意此數列本身僅自2016年起才有資料，因此這裡的整段歷史z實際上只涵蓋2016年至2026年，並非羅盤其他部分涵蓋的完整2001年至2026年。就絕對、跨國水準而言，台灣是全世界最難負擔的市場之一；此量表讀的是台灣自己的歷史，不是那個絕對水準。
tw.card_pop_en: Population reads -0.62, negative — Taiwan's population is shrinking, a structural headwind for long-run housing demand.
tw.card_pop_zh: 人口讀數為-0.62，為負值——台灣人口正在萎縮，對長期房屋需求構成結構性逆風。
tw.card_sup_en: Supply is at its loosest on record (z=−2.5) — the low-electricity vacancy proxy shows an unusually large stock of empty units.
tw.card_sup_zh: 供給處於紀錄上最寬鬆（z=−2.5）——低度用電空屋代理指標顯示空置存量異常龐大。
tw.traj_en: Over the recent cycle Taiwan moved from fuelled (2019Q1-2022Q3) into draining (2022Q4-2024Q1), briefly returned to fuelled (2024Q2-2025Q1), passed through reflating (2025Q2), and has sat in starved since 2025Q3.
tw.traj_zh: 近期週期中，台灣先是處於「油門全開」（2019Q1至2022Q3），接著轉入「資金抽離」（2022Q4至2024Q1），短暫回到「油門全開」（2024Q2至2025Q1），經過「回溫」（2025Q2），並自2025Q3起持續落在「下行·斷炊」。
tw.xc_val_en: Vs the world right now, Taiwan is the most expensive of the four markets covered here: PTI of 16x ranks 10th of 12, gross yield of just 1.8% is dead last (12th), and the valuation composite of -0.93 is the worst reading in the set. That's the opposite conclusion from the self-history gauge, which reads Taiwan near-neutral (z≈0) — a decade of uniformly high prices simply hasn't left Taiwan's own history any cheap quarters to compare against. Measured against the world instead, the gap shows up in full.
tw.xc_val_zh: 放進世界一起排名，台灣是這四個市場中最貴的一個：房價所得比16倍排名第10，毛租金報酬率僅1.8%是12個市場中最差（第12），估值綜合分數-0.93也是這組數字裡最差的讀數。這與自身歷史量表的結論恰好相反——那套量表把台灣讀成接近中段（z≈0），原因是台灣過去十年價格本身就一路偏貴，自身歷史裡根本找不到便宜的季度可以比較。換成跟世界比，這個落差才完整顯現出來。
tw.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is -0.5%, ranked 4th — better than the US but still negative: rental income does not cover the mortgage, so holding still leans on further price gains rather than paid-in-full economics.
tw.xc_carry_zh: 利差為-0.5%，排名第4——比美國好一些，但仍是負值：租金收入無法覆蓋房貸，持有仍仰賴房價繼續上漲，而不是靠現金流打平。
tw.risk_en: Taiwan shows the same light — Starved with the supply-glut flag lit — but this warning was never validated here, and it should not be read as one. In Taiwan's one recorded loss episode ({EP_START}-{EP_END}), the classifier never fired: it caught 0 of that 1 episode. Across the full pre-registered test it fell short of the pass bar on both claims (absolute-loss odds ratio {OR_ABS}×, against a bar of 3×; relative-weakness odds ratio {OR_REL}×, against a bar of 2×) — largely because Taiwan's usable history is short and almost one-directional, leaving too few down-quarters to learn from. Showing an odds number here as if it meant something would manufacture a signal this market's history never produced. Read Taiwan's compass above as descriptive of the past only — this light carries no validated meaning.
tw.risk_zh: 台灣顯示同一盞燈——斷炊疊加供給過剩警示——但這個警示在台灣從未通過驗證，也不該被當作訊號讀取。在台灣紀錄中唯一一次虧損事件（{EP_START}至{EP_END}）中，這套分類器完全沒有觸發：一次事件，零次抓到。在完整的預先凍結測試中，台灣在兩項宣稱上都未達通過門檻（絕對虧損勝算比{OR_ABS}倍，門檻為3倍；相對弱勢勝算比{OR_REL}倍，門檻為2倍）——主要原因是台灣可用歷史過短、且幾乎單向，留下的下跌季度太少，不足以學習。在這裡秀出一個勝算比數字、彷彿它代表什麼，等於捏造出一個台灣歷史根本沒產生過的訊號。請把上方台灣的羅盤讀數只當作對過去的描述——這盞燈本身不帶任何已驗證的意義。

my.judge_en: The compass reads downtrend-starved: price momentum is negative (z=-0.36) and credit impulse is negative too (z=-0.24), meaning prices are losing steam while credit growth cools alongside them. Malaysia is a "welded" market where nominal prices essentially never fall, so a starved reading doesn't show up as a decline but as an anaemic 1.7% YoY — the tailwind behind the 2023-25 run has faded.
my.judge_zh: 羅盤讀數為下行．斷炊：價格動能為負（z=-0.36），信貸脈衝同步為負（z=-0.24），代表房價正在失去動能，信貸擴張也同步降溫。馬來西亞是「焊死」型市場，名目房價幾乎不曾下跌，因此斷炊訊號不會表現為房價下跌，而是年增率放緩至僅1.7%——支撐2023至2025年那波上漲的動力已經消退。
my.warn_en: Supply-glut warning is ON: NAPIC overhang data shows completions and unsold/vacant stock running loose relative to the recent cycle (a trailing ~6-year window), which caps pricing power even while headline prices still hold in positive territory.
my.warn_zh: 供給過剩警訊為開啟：NAPIC餘屋數據顯示，相對於近幾年常態（約6年的滾動窗），完工量與未售出／空置庫存都偏鬆偏高，即便表面房價仍維持正成長，漲價空間已被壓抑。
my.card_val_en: Mid-range against Malaysia's own history (z≈0) — neither cheap nor stretched by its own standard. One caveat: the income denominator is DOSM's median household income, interpolated between sparse survey years and held flat at RM7,017 since 2024, so this gauge's recent movement is driven mostly by price, not income.
my.card_val_zh: 相對馬來西亞自身歷史落在中段（z≈0）——以自身標準衡量，既不便宜也不緊繃。但有一點須留意：所得分母採自DOSM的中位數家庭所得，是在稀疏的調查年份之間內插而成，並自2024年起凍結在RM7,017，因此這個量表近期的變動，主要來自房價而非所得。
my.card_pop_en: Population reads +2.06 on the absolute scale — Malaysia's population is still growing at roughly 1.4% a year, a modest tailwind for housing demand.
my.card_pop_zh: 人口讀數為+2.06（絕對值尺度）——馬來西亞人口仍以約每年1.4%的速度成長，對房屋需求構成溫和順風。
my.card_sup_en: Supply is loose (z=−1.2) — NAPIC's unsold overhang sits high in Malaysia's own history.
my.card_sup_zh: 供給寬鬆（z=−1.2）——NAPIC 未售餘屋在馬來西亞自身歷史中偏高。
my.traj_en: Malaysia moved from starved (2021Q2-2022Q2) into a draining phase where prices still rose but credit tightened (2022Q3-2023Q3), then a fully fuelled rally (2023Q4-2025Q3), briefly touched reflating in 2025Q4, and has fallen back to starved as of 2026Q1.
my.traj_zh: 馬來西亞的走勢先是斷炊期（2021Q2至2022Q2），轉入房價仍漲、但信貸轉緊的失血期（2022Q3至2023Q3），接著進入全力上漲的旺漲期（2023Q4至2025Q3），2025Q4短暫回溫，到2026Q1又落回斷炊。
my.xc_val_en: Malaysia ranks well on both valuation inputs: PTI of 11x is the 4th-cheapest of 12 markets and gross yield of 5.2% is the 3rd-highest, combining into the best valuation composite in the set at +0.62. Unlike the US or Taiwan, there's no split verdict here — Malaysia reads reasonably priced against both its own history (z≈0) and the world.
my.xc_val_zh: 馬來西亞在兩項估值指標上都排名靠前：房價所得比11倍是12個市場中第4便宜，毛租金報酬率5.2%是第3高，兩者合成出這組數字裡最好的估值綜合分數，+0.62。與美國或台灣不同，這裡沒有出現分歧的結論——馬來西亞相對自身歷史（z≈0）與相對世界，讀數都算合理。
my.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is positive at +1.2%, ranked 3rd of 12 — rental income clears the mortgage rate with room to spare, so a Malaysian property is closer to paying for itself than feeding the owner each month. The one weak spot in the picture is vacancy at 15%, ranked 11th of 12 — plenty of empty stock competing for that rent.
my.xc_carry_zh: 利差為正值+1.2%，在12個市場中排名第3——租金收入足以覆蓋房貸利率並留有餘裕，代表馬來西亞的房產比較接近自己養活自己，而不是每月倒貼。畫面裡唯一的弱點是空置率15%，排名第11——有不少空置存量在跟這份租金競爭。
my.risk_en: The mechanism: same Starved-plus-glut pairing, tested against Malaysia's own history. The number: Malaysia has never recorded a 3-year nominal price loss, so the absolute-loss odds can't be rated here — that's stated plainly rather than invented. What is measurable: quarters carrying this combination landed in Malaysia's own worst quartile of outcomes {PREC_REL}% of the time, against {PREC_REL_OFF}% when the warning was off — an odds ratio of {OR_REL}×. What it means for a buyer: not 'prices will fall' — this market has never done that on record — but growth this weak, this consistently, has historically meant Malaysia's worst quartile of outcomes, not its best. The light is ON right now.
my.risk_zh: 機制：同一組斷炊疊加供給過剩的組合，套用在馬來西亞自身歷史上檢驗。數字：馬來西亞歷史紀錄中從未出現過三年期名目虧損，因此無法在此為絕對虧損機率評級——這裡誠實說明，而非捏造數字。可衡量的是：帶有此組合的季度，落入馬來西亞自身最差四分之一表現的比例為{PREC_REL}%，警示關閉時僅{PREC_REL_OFF}%——勝算比{OR_REL}倍。對買家的意義：不是「房價會跌」——這個市場的紀錄上從未發生過——而是這種持續偏弱的成長，過去對應的往往是馬來西亞表現最差的四分之一區間，而非最好的區間。這盞燈目前是開啟的。

jp.judge_en: Japan's compass reads Uptrend·Draining: house prices are still rising (momentum z=+0.44, YoY at 5%), but the credit impulse behind them is contracting sharply (z=-2.36). That combination — rising prices without expanding credit — has historically been fragile: draining-cell quarters carry a median forward-3y return of -2.3% (n=38), well below fuelled uptrends' +6%. For a market that already lived through a real bubble and a 14-year crash (1991 peak to 2005), a credit-starved rally is not a state to get comfortable in.
jp.judge_zh: 日本羅盤讀數為「上行·資金退」：房價仍在上漲（動能 z=+0.44，年增率5%），但背後的信貸動能正劇烈萎縮（z=-2.36）。這種「價格上漲、信貸卻不擴張」的組合，過去表現偏脆弱：資金退象限的季度，未來三年報酬中位數為-2.3%（n=38），遠低於有燃料上行的+6%。對這個曾經歷過真正泡沫、並崩跌長達十四年（1991年見頂至2005年）的市場而言，一段缺乏信貸支撐的漲勢並非可以安心的狀態。
jp.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is on: Japan's 空き家率 (vacancy rate) reading is at an extreme (vacancy z=-2.7), reflecting the country's large and growing stock of empty homes — a structural overhang sitting underneath whatever near-term price momentum shows up. This flag rides almost entirely on that vacancy series, which comes from the 住宅・土地統計調査 (Housing and Land Survey), a five-yearly survey held constant between releases rather than a live quarterly read.
jp.warn_zh: 供給過剩警示已觸發：日本的「空き家率」（空屋率）讀數處於極端水準（空置率 z=-2.7），反映出全國龐大且持續增加的空屋存量——這是壓在任何短期房價動能之下的結構性過剩。這面警示幾乎完全仰賴這條空置率數列，其來源是「住宅・土地統計調査」（住宅與土地統計調查），一份每五年才更新一次、期間維持不變的調查，並非逐季更新的即時數據。
jp.card_val_en: Slightly below its own historical middle (z=+0.2) — but only because the 1991 bubble tops the record; in absolute terms Japanese housing relative to income is still high.
jp.card_val_zh: 略低於自身歷史中位（z=+0.2）——但這只因為 1991 年泡沫佔據紀錄頂點；就絕對水準而言，日本房價相對所得仍偏高。
jp.card_pop_en: Population reads -0.74, confirming Japan's demographic reality: the population is shrinking rather than growing, which erodes structural housing demand over time.
jp.card_pop_zh: 人口讀數為-0.74，印證了日本的人口現實：人口正在萎縮而非成長，長期將侵蝕房屋的結構性需求。
jp.card_sup_en: Supply is moderately loose (z=−0.8) — the 空き家率 vacancy rate is elevated, a large empty-home stock, though new completions have thinned.
jp.card_sup_zh: 供給中度寬鬆（z=−0.8）——空き家率偏高，龐大的空屋存量，不過新完工量已變薄。
jp.traj_en: Since 2019, Japan's compass moved from reflating (2019Q3-2021Q1) into a fuelled uptrend (2021Q2-2022Q1), then slid into draining (2022Q2-2023Q4), briefly touched starved in 2024Q1, and has sat in draining again from 2024Q2 through 2025Q4 — a rally that keeps losing its credit support.
jp.traj_zh: 自2019年起，日本的羅盤讀數從資金回流（2019Q3至2021Q1）轉入有燃料的上行（2021Q2至2022Q1），接著滑入資金退（2022Q2至2023Q4），2024Q1一度觸及斷炊，並自2024Q2到2025Q4再度停留在資金退——一段不斷失去信貸支撐的漲勢。
jp.xc_val_en: Japan's valuation composite is +0.19, close to the US's +0.30 but reached differently: PTI of 15x ranks 8th (unremarkable) while yield of 4.3% ranks 7th — a middling combination, not a standout-cheap market. Against its own history the price-to-income ratio also reads only slightly below its 1991-bubble-skewed middle (z=+0.2); on both frames Japan is ordinary on price — that's not the story here.
jp.xc_val_zh: 日本的估值綜合分數為+0.19，跟美國的+0.30相近，但成因不同：房價所得比15倍排名第8（不算突出），租金報酬率4.3%排名第7——是一個中段的組合，並非特別便宜的市場。相對自身歷史，房價所得比也只是略低於被1991年泡沫拉高的中位數（z=+0.2）；不論哪個座標，日本在價格這件事上都偏普通，這不是它的故事重點。
jp.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is +2.5%, ranked 2nd of 12 and the best in the set on this measure — ultra-low mortgage rates mean rent covers financing with the widest margin of any market here. The catch is on the other side of the ledger: population growth is -0.5%, the worst of all 12 markets, so the demand base funding that rent is shrinking.
jp.xc_carry_zh: 利差為+2.5%，在12個市場中排名第2，是這組數字裡最好的讀數——超低房貸利率讓租金能以最大的餘裕覆蓋融資成本。問題出在天秤的另一端：人口成長率為-0.5%，是全部12個市場中最差的一個，代表撐起這份租金的需求基礎正在萎縮。
jp.risk_en: The mechanism: same pairing as the US test — Starved plus a live supply-glut flag — evaluated on the one market here that lived through a real multi-decade bust. The number: when this combination has fired historically, {PREC_ABS}% of the following quarters were followed by a 3-year nominal loss (vs {PREC_ABS_OFF}% off, OR {OR_ABS}×), and {PREC_REL}% landed in Japan's own worst quartile (vs {PREC_REL_OFF}% off, OR {OR_REL}×) — the strongest bottom-quartile read of any market tested. What it means right now: the light is OFF — Japan currently sits in Draining, not Starved, so this specific warning isn't flashing. That doesn't clear the credit-starved rally described in the compass panel above; it just means the risk gauge, which only fires on the Starved-plus-glut combination, is quiet for now.
jp.risk_zh: 機制：與美國測試同一組合——斷炊疊加正在亮燈的供給過剩警示——套用在這裡唯一真正經歷過數十年崩盤的市場上。數字：這個組合過去觸發時，其後三年出現名目虧損的比例為{PREC_ABS}%（警示關閉時為{PREC_ABS_OFF}%，勝算比{OR_ABS}倍），落入日本自身最差四分之一的比例為{PREC_REL}%（警示關閉時為{PREC_REL_OFF}%，勝算比{OR_REL}倍）——是所有受測市場中最強的最差四分之一讀數。對現在的意義：這盞燈目前是關閉的——日本現處於資金退，而非斷炊，因此這個特定警示尚未亮起。這不代表上方羅盤面板描述的「缺信貸支撐的漲勢」已經解除；只是說明只在斷炊疊加供給過剩組合才會觸發的風險警報，目前是安靜的。

au.judge_en: The compass places Australia in Uptrend · Fuelled: price momentum is positive (z=+0.32, house prices up 10.0% year-on-year) and the real credit impulse is expanding alongside it (z=+0.38) — prices and mortgage credit accelerating together, the textbook fuelled pairing. One honesty note specific to Australia: across its full 50-year record the four-cell ordering doesn't hold the way it does in the US, Malaysia or Japan — quarters classified fuelled went on to a median 3-year gain of 16.1% (n=34), actually below starved quarters' 22.3% (n=44). Australia has essentially never lived through a real multi-year bust to teach the ordering what its weakest cell should look like, so read this fuelled reading as a description of the current mix, not a ranked forecast of what comes next.
au.judge_zh: 羅盤把澳洲放在「上行．有燃料」：房價動能為正（z=+0.32，房價年增10.0%），背後的實質信貸脈衝同步擴張（z=+0.38）——房價與房貸信貸一起加速，是教科書式的有燃料組合。有一點是澳洲特有的誠實但書：放進完整50年紀錄來看，四格排序在這裡並不像在美國、馬來西亞或日本那樣成立——被歸類為有燃料的季度，其後三年報酬中位數為16.1%（n=34），反而低於斷炊季度的22.3%（n=44）。澳洲基本上從未經歷過真正的多年期崩盤，教不了這套排序「最弱一格」該長什麼樣子，因此這個有燃料讀數應理解為對當下組合的描述，而非對未來的排序式預測。
au.warn_en: The supply-glut warning is OFF this quarter — vacancy and building approvals both run tighter than Australia's own recent norm rather than looser, consistent with a rental market that, per the cross-country panel below, already has the tightest vacancy rate of all 12 markets tracked (1.2%, rank 1 of 12). The chronic story in Australia has been too little stock, not too much.
au.warn_zh: 本季供給過剩警示為關閉——空置率與建築核准量都比澳洲近期常態更緊，而非更鬆，與下方跨國面板所顯示、澳洲租屋空置率是所追蹤12個市場中最緊的（1.2%，第1名／12個市場）一致。澳洲長期以來的故事是庫存太少，而不是太多。
au.card_val_en: Valuation sits on the expensive side of Australia's own 50-year record (z=−1.06) — not the extreme the US shows against its own history, but priced above its long-run norm relative to income, and the trend has moved steadily further in that direction over the past year.
au.card_val_zh: 估值落在澳洲自身50年紀錄中偏貴的一側（z=−1.06）——不像美國相對自身歷史那樣極端，但相對所得已高於長期常態，且過去一年這個趨勢持續朝更貴的方向移動。
au.card_pop_en: Population reads blank for 2026Q1 — not a data gap in the underlying series but a genuine publication lag: the ABS Estimated Resident Population release for this quarter hasn't come out yet. The most recent available reading, as of 2025Q4, put growth at roughly +2.3% year-on-year — among the fastest of the 12 markets tracked on this page — this gauge will populate once ABS publishes the new figure.
au.card_pop_zh: 人口量表在2026Q1顯示空白——這不是底層數列本身有缺口，而是真實存在的發布時滯：ABS（澳洲統計局）的估計居民人口這一季的數字尚未公布。最近一次可得讀數截至2025Q4，年增率約為+2.3%——在本頁追蹤的12個市場中屬於較快的一端——待ABS公布新一季數字後，這個量表就會補上。
au.card_sup_en: Supply reads tight against Australia's own history (z=+1.11) — vacancy and building approvals both run lower than the local historical norm, consistent with the chronic under-building this market has become known for.
au.card_sup_zh: 供給相對澳洲自身歷史偏緊（z=+1.11）——空置率與建築核准量都低於當地歷史常態，與這個市場長期以來「蓋得不夠」的形象一致。
au.traj_en: Since 2018, Australia sat in an extended starved stretch through the pre-pandemic slowdown (2018Q2-2020Q4), moved into draining through the pandemic-era credit boom (2021Q1-2021Q4, with a single fuelled quarter in 2022Q1), fell back through draining into starved as rates rose (2022Q2-2023Q4), drained again through most of 2024 with a brief fuelled touch in 2024Q4, spent four straight quarters reflating (2025Q1-2025Q4) as credit turned up ahead of prices, and has sat in fuelled since 2026Q1.
au.traj_zh: 自2018年起，澳洲先是經歷疫情前放緩期間的長段斷炊（2018Q2至2020Q4），接著在疫情期信貸熱潮中轉入資金退（2021Q1至2021Q4，2022Q1曾短暫觸及有燃料），隨升息又跌回資金退、再落入斷炊（2022Q2至2023Q4），2024年大半時間再度資金退、2024Q4短暫觸及有燃料，2025年連續四季處於資金回流（2025Q1至2025Q4，信貸領先房價回升），並自2026Q1起持續停留在有燃料。
au.xc_val_en: Ranked against the other 11 markets, Australia comes out expensive: PTI of 13x ranks a middling 7th, but gross yield of just 2.8% ranks 11th of 12 — near the bottom — pulling the valuation composite down to −0.77, solidly in the expensive tier. That's a sharper verdict than the self-history gauge above (z=−1.06, expensive but not extreme): Australia looks worse against the world than against its own past.
au.xc_val_zh: 放進其他11個市場一起排名，澳洲顯得偏貴：房價所得比13倍排名中段第7，但毛租金報酬率僅2.8%，在12個市場中排名第11——接近墊底——把估值綜合分數拉低到−0.77，穩穩落在偏貴的一層。這比上方自身歷史量表的結論更嚴峻（z=−1.06，偏貴但不極端）：澳洲相對世界看起來比相對自己的過去更糟。
au.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is −3.5%, ranked 11th of 12 — near the worst in the set: the mortgage rate runs well ahead of rental yield, so a levered Australian buyer is feeding the property every month with little cash-flow relief. Set against that, Australia holds the tightest vacancy rate of all 12 markets (1.2%, rank 1) and the second-fastest population growth (+2.3%, rank 2) — the paradox at the heart of this market: near-worst carry economics, but structurally underpinned by demand with nowhere to go and a rental stock too thin to absorb it.
au.xc_carry_zh: 利差為−3.5%，在12個市場中排名第11——接近墊底：房貸利率遠高於租金報酬率，代表槓桿持有的澳洲買家每月都在大幅倒貼，幾乎沒有現金流喘息空間。與此對照，澳洲擁有12個市場中最緊的空置率（1.2%，第1名）與第二快的人口成長（+2.3%，第2名）——這正是這個市場的核心矛盾：持有經濟學幾乎墊底，卻有無處可去的需求與薄到裝不下的租屋存量在結構上撐著它。
au.risk_en: The mechanism: the same Starved-plus-supply-glut pairing tested on the US, Taiwan, Malaysia and Japan — but Australia was never part of that original test. It is added afterward, frozen as an out-of-sample check the classifier was never fit to. Two things are true here. First, Australia can't be rated on the absolute-loss claim: across fifty years it has recorded only 2 quarters that led to a matured 3-year nominal loss, against the ≥8 needed to say anything meaningful — stated plainly, not estimated. Second, on the relative-weakness claim it can be scored: quarters carrying this combination landed in Australia's own worst quartile of outcomes {PREC_REL}% of the time, against a {BASE_REL}% base rate — an odds ratio of {OR_REL}×. Read the fine print, though: recall is only {RECALL_REL}% — this combination has fired for just a handful of Australia's genuinely weak quarters, so most of the market's soft patches happened without this light ever turning on. What it means for a buyer: this is the gauge meeting its first true out-of-sample market, and it should be read as exactly that — a thin, weakly-evidenced signal in a market that has essentially never had the kind of bust the underlying claim was built to catch. The light is currently OFF — Australia sits in Fuelled, not Starved.
au.risk_zh: 機制：與美國、台灣、馬來西亞、日本測試的同一組合——斷炊疊加供給過剩警示——但澳洲並未參與最初的那次測試，而是事後加入，做為這套分類器從未被套用過的樣本外檢驗，且在跑任何數字前就已凍結。這裡有兩件事同時成立。第一，澳洲無法在絕對虧損宣稱上被評級：五十年間，澳洲只出現過2個導致三年期名目虧損完成觀測的季度，遠低於需要的≥8個門檻——這裡誠實說明，而非估算填補。第二，相對弱勢宣稱則可以評分：帶有此組合的季度，落入澳洲自身最差四分之一表現的比例為{PREC_REL}%，對照{BASE_REL}%的基準比例——勝算比{OR_REL}倍。但請留意細節：召回率僅{RECALL_REL}%——這個組合只在澳洲少數幾個真正偏弱的季度觸發，代表這個市場大多數的疲弱期，這盞燈根本沒有亮起。對買家的意義：這是這套警報第一次遇上真正的樣本外市場，也應該被這樣解讀——在一個基本上從未發生過這套宣稱原本要抓的那種崩盤的市場裡，這是一個薄弱、證據不足的訊號。這盞燈目前是關閉的——澳洲現處於有燃料，而非斷炊。

th.judge_en: The live reading is 2025Q4, not 2026Q1: the BIS Bangkok price index is published one quarter ahead of the BIS household-credit series, and the missing credit value has deliberately not been carried forward, so the newest row on the compass is an incomplete warm-up cell rather than a reading. At 2025Q4 the compass places Thailand in Downtrend · Starved: price momentum is negative (z = −0.78) and the real credit impulse is contracting alongside it (z = −0.50), with nominal Bangkok prices up only 0.6% year-on-year. Starved is the weakest of the four cells in Thailand's own record, carrying a median 3-year forward nominal gain of 7.1% (n=49) against 18.8% for fuelled quarters. On the price leg alone momentum has deteriorated further into 2026Q1 (z = −1.00); whether the cell is still starved cannot be stated until the credit series catches up.
th.judge_zh: 本頁讀數以 2025Q4 為準，非 2026Q1：BIS 曼谷房價指數較 BIS 家庭信貸數列早一季發布，缺漏的信貸值刻意不以前期數值填補，羅盤最新一列因此是不完整的暖機格，不構成讀數。2025Q4 的羅盤位置為下行·斷炊：房價動能為負（z=−0.78），實質信貸脈衝同步收縮（z=−0.50），曼谷名目房價年增僅 0.6%。在泰國自身紀錄中，斷炊是四格裡最弱的一格，其後三年名目報酬中位數為 7.1%（n=49），有燃料格則為 18.8%。僅就房價腿而言，進入 2026Q1 動能繼續劣化（z=−1.00）；格位是否仍為斷炊，須待信貸數列補齊後方能認定。
th.warn_en: Supply is not measurable for Thailand: no quarterly inventory, absorption or vacancy series exists to form the glut term, so this gauge is blank rather than negative. That is not a statement that supply is adequate — this site's own Bangkok report documents 210,112 unsold units and 49.5 months of stock.
th.warn_zh: 泰國的供給無法衡量：不存在可用的季度庫存、去化或空置數列，無法構成供給過剩項，此量表為缺值，而非「無過剩」。這並不表示供給充足：本站曼谷市場報告記錄 210,112 戶未售存量與 49.5 個月的去化月數。
th.card_val_en: Valuation reads −1.04 at 2025Q4, on the expensive side of Thailand's own record: Bangkok prices have outrun earnings. Two limits attach to this gauge. The denominator is ILOSTAT average monthly earnings per employee, not the household disposable income used for the other markets on this page, so Thailand's valuation reading is not unit-comparable across markets and should be read only against its own history. And that history is short: the earnings series begins in 2014Q1, so the first standardised reading is 2017Q1 and the base it is standardised against stays thin for several years after that.
th.card_val_zh: 估值於 2025Q4 為 −1.04，落在泰國自身紀錄偏貴的一側：曼谷房價漲幅高於所得。此量表有兩項限制。其一，分母採 ILOSTAT 平均每受僱者月收入，而非本頁其他市場所用的家庭可支配所得，泰國的估值讀數因此與其他市場不具單位可比性，只能對照自身歷史閱讀。其二，這段歷史很短：所得數列自 2014Q1 才開始，第一個標準化讀數落在 2017Q1，其後數年的標準化基期仍然偏薄。
th.card_pop_en: Population reads −0.10 on the absolute scale. The magnitude is small but the direction is real: Thailand's population peaked in 2022 and has fallen in every year since, so the demand base is contracting rather than merely growing more slowly. The input is the World Bank annual level stepped onto a quarterly axis, so it moves once a year and 2026Q1 has not been published.
th.card_pop_zh: 人口讀數為 −0.10（絕對值尺度）。數值不大，但方向為真：泰國人口於 2022 年見頂，其後逐年下滑，需求基礎屬於收縮，而非僅是成長放緩。輸入值為世界銀行年度水準值階梯化至季頻，一年只變動一次，2026Q1 尚未發布。
th.card_sup_en: Supply is not measurable for Thailand, and the gauge is blank for that reason alone. No official quarterly inventory, absorption or vacancy series exists: REIC publishes into an application that cannot be extracted, and the private surveys are annual, begin around 2021 and disagree by more than 60% on the same “Greater Bangkok unsold units” concept. Nothing has been substituted for the missing series — no proxy, no carried-forward value, no imputation — because a manufactured number here would feed straight into the risk gauge below. Read the blank as an instrument limit, not as a benign reading: this site's own Bangkok report documents 210,112 unsold units and 49.5 months of stock, which is severe oversupply. The honest statement is that the supply state is unknown to this engine, while the evidence outside it points to a glut.
th.card_sup_zh: 泰國的供給無法衡量，本量表留白僅出於此一原因。泰國不存在官方季度庫存、去化或空置數列：REIC 的資料發布於無法擷取的應用介面，民間調查則為年度頻率、約自 2021 年起算，且對同一個「大曼谷未售存量」概念的估計差異超過 60%。缺漏的數列未以任何方式替代，不採代理變數、不沿用前期數值、不做插補，因為此處填入的任何數字都會直接傳導至下方的風險警報。此一留白應解讀為儀器限制，而非良性讀數：本站曼谷市場報告記錄 210,112 戶未售存量與 49.5 個月的去化月數，屬於嚴重供給過剩。誠實的表述是：本引擎不知道泰國的供給狀態，而引擎之外的證據指向過剩。
th.traj_en: Thailand has spent most of the past decade below the momentum axis: draining from 2014Q1 to 2016Q2, starved from 2016Q3 to 2018Q1 and again from 2018Q4 to 2020Q1, a reflating window through the first pandemic year (2020Q2–2021Q1), starved from 2021Q2 to 2022Q3, draining to 2023Q3, starved from 2023Q4 to 2024Q4, a two-quarter draining interruption in the first half of 2025, and starved again from 2025Q3. Forty-nine of the 111 scored quarters fall in the starved cell, more than any other. Thailand is also the market where the four-cell ordering was tested out of sample and came back positive: Spearman ρ = 0.527 across those 111 quarters (1995Q3–2023Q1), above the pre-registered 0.3 bar, with fuelled the best cell (median 18.8% three-year forward, n=29) and starved the worst (7.1%, n=49). Five of the six declared pairs are concordant; the one inversion is draining below reflating, and reflating is the thinnest cell in the sample (n=9). Only Malaysia scores higher (0.71); the US is 0.58, Japan 0.40, Taiwan 0.081 and Australia −0.156. This result validates the ordering claim and nothing else — in particular it is not evidence for the risk gauge, which cannot be formed for Thailand at all.
th.traj_zh: 泰國過去十年大多數時間位於動能軸下方：2014Q1 至 2016Q2 為資金退，2016Q3 至 2018Q1 與 2018Q4 至 2020Q1 兩段為斷炊，疫情第一年（2020Q2 至 2021Q1）轉為資金回流，2021Q2 至 2022Q3 再度斷炊，至 2023Q3 為資金退，2023Q4 至 2024Q4 斷炊，2025 年上半年有兩季資金退的中斷，2025Q3 起又回到斷炊。111 個可評分季度中有 49 個落在斷炊格，多於任何其他格。泰國也是四格排序接受樣本外檢定且結果為正的市場：這 111 個季度（1995Q3 至 2023Q1）的 Spearman ρ = 0.527，高於預先凍結的 0.3 門檻，有燃料格為最佳（其後三年報酬中位 18.8%，n=29），斷炊格為最差（7.1%，n=49）。六組宣告配對中有五組一致，唯一反轉為資金退低於資金回流，而資金回流是樣本中最薄的一格（n=9）。僅馬來西亞得分更高（0.71），美國為 0.58，日本 0.40，台灣 0.081，澳洲 −0.156。此一結果只驗證了排序這項宣稱，不延伸至其他：它特別不構成風險警報的證據，因為那套警報在泰國根本無法構成。
th.xc_val_en: Ranked against the other 11 markets, Thailand splits: price-to-income of 19x ranks 11th of 12, near the bottom, while a gross yield of 5.0% ranks 4th. The valuation composite nets out at −0.59, in the expensive tier. The two readings are not in conflict: Bangkok rents are high relative to Bangkok prices, while Bangkok prices are very high relative to Thai earnings — an investor with capital sees a workable yield, a household buying to live does not see an affordable price. One construction note: Thailand publishes no official price-to-income series, so this cross-sectional figure is a 2026 snapshot from the site's cross-market dataset, on a different basis from the self-history valuation gauge above. The two frames should be read side by side, not merged.
th.xc_val_zh: 放進其他 11 個市場一起排名，泰國的讀數分歧：房價所得比 19 倍在 12 個市場中排名第 11，接近墊底，毛租金報酬率 5.0% 則排名第 4。估值綜合分數合計為 −0.59，落在偏貴的一層。兩項讀數並不衝突：曼谷租金相對曼谷房價偏高，而曼谷房價相對泰國所得極高：持有資本的投資人看到的是可行的收益率，自住購屋的家庭看到的不是可負擔的價格。另有一項口徑說明：泰國未發布官方房價所得比數列，此跨國數字為本站跨市場資料集的 2026 年快照，與上方的自身歷史估值量表基礎不同。兩個座標應並列閱讀，不合併。
th.xc_carry_en: Carry spread is −2.4%, ranked 9th of 12: against a mortgage rate near 7.4% and a 5.0% gross yield, a levered Bangkok purchase runs a monthly cash deficit and the return has to come from price. Two of the remaining ranks are worse. Vacancy at 18% is last of 12, and population growth at −0.2% ranks 10th. The vacancy figure carries one caution: it is a 2026 snapshot derived from an unsold-stock estimate in a different reference frame, not a quarterly series, so it is used for cross-sectional ranking only and is never fed into the supply gauge or the glut warning above. That is why those read not measurable even though this bar ranks worst of 12 — a snapshot can rank a market, it cannot date the quarter a glut began.
th.xc_carry_zh: 持有利差為 −2.4%，在 12 個市場中排名第 9：對照約 7.4% 的房貸利率與 5.0% 的毛租金報酬率，槓桿持有曼谷物件每月呈現現金缺口，報酬只能來自價格。其余排名中有兩項更差：空置率 18% 為 12 個市場中最差，人口成長 −0.2% 排名第 10。空置率這個數字需要一項保留：它是以另一套參照框架的未售存量估值推導而來的 2026 年快照，並非季度數列，因此只用於跨國排名，絕不回填至上方的供給量表或供給過剩警示。這也是上方兩者顯示無法衡量、本欄却排名墊底的原因：快照可以為市場排名，却無法標定過剩從哪一季開始。
th.risk_en: The risk gauge is NOT EVALUABLE for Thailand, and was therefore not evaluated. The classifier under test is a conjunction — a starved cell AND a live supply glut — and Thailand has no supply series at all, so the second term is undefined rather than false and the classifier cannot be formed. No proxy was substituted, no 2x2 table was computed, the applicability gate was not applied, and no odds ratio is quoted here, because any number printed in this slot would be manufactured. This is a stronger statement than Australia's NOT RATED: Australia's gauge computes normally and merely lacks enough matured loss events to be scored against (2 qualifying quarters against a pre-registered minimum of 8), so it can be rated once its history supplies them. Thailand's gauge cannot be computed at any sample size until a Thai quarterly inventory or vacancy series exists. What it means for a buyer: the absence of a warning light here carries no information in either direction and must not be read as the absence of supply risk. The compass reading at {CUR_Q} is starved, and the site's own Bangkok report documents a severe glut that this engine cannot see.
th.risk_zh: 風險警報對泰國屬於無法評估，因此並未進行評估。受測的分類規則是一個連言條件：斷炊格且供給過剩警示亮燈。泰國完全沒有供給數列，第二項因此屬於未定義，而非為假，分類規則無法成立。本頁未採用任何代理變數、未計算 2x2 列聯表、未套用適用性門檻，也不引用任何勝算比，因為此處列出的任何數字都屬捏造。這個表述比澳洲的未評級更強：澳洲的警報可以正常計算，只是已完成觀測的虧損事件不足以評分（符合條件的季度僅 2 個，預設門檻為 8 個），後續歷史若提供足夠事件即可評級。泰國則是在泰國出現季度庫存或空置數列之前，不論樣本多大都無法計算。對買家的意義：此處沒有警示燈，在兩個方向上都不攜帶資訊，也不得解讀為供給風險不存在。{CUR_Q} 的羅盤讀數為斷炊，本站曼谷市場報告也記錄了一個本引擎看不見的嚴重供給過剩。

method.lede_en: A house market asks three questions that one number can't answer at once — where prices are headed, whether the market is healthy, and whether it is flashing the specific warning signs that have, historically, preceded a real loss. This page keeps them on three separate instruments. The Compass orders direction from momentum and credit — a description of the past; a later attempt to validate that ordering as a forward call failed its own pre-registered gates (detail). The Report Card diagnoses condition — valuation, population, supply — describing health without pretending to time it. The Risk Gauge is the one instrument here with a tested forward claim: a frozen, pre-registered test (detail) found that Starved-plus-supply-glut quarters carry real, elevated odds of a loss or a bottom-quartile outcome, in the markets that have ever had one to learn from. Three jobs, three tools, never blended into a single score.
method.lede_zh: 一個房市同時問三個問題，而一個數字無法一次回答——價格接下來往哪走、這個市場健不健康、以及它是否亮起那種過去曾預示真實虧損的特定警示訊號。這頁把三者放在三套分開的儀器上。羅盤只用動能與信貸為方向排序——這是對過去的描述；後續一次想把這個排序驗證為前向預測的嘗試，未能通過自己預先凍結的門檻（詳情）。健檢卡診斷體質——估值、人口、供給——描述健康狀況，而不假裝拿它來抓時機。風險警報是這裡唯一一套通過前向驗證的儀器：一次凍結、預先設定門檻的測試（詳情）發現，斷炊疊加供給過剩的季度，在曾經出現過虧損可供學習的市場中，確實帶有真實、明顯偏高的虧損或落入最差四分之一表現的機率。三種工作、三套工具，絕不合併成單一分數。
method.why_en: The split isn't a stylistic choice — it's what the data forces. Test each force on its own against three-year forward house-price returns across the US, Taiwan, Malaysia and Japan, and momentum is the only one that works everywhere: quarters following price uptrends beat quarters following downtrends by 7 to 14 points, in every market, no exceptions. Valuation fails the same test — it mean-reverts the way textbooks promise in cyclical markets, but in Japan it reversed by 18.9 points, because post-1990 cheapness there was structural decay, not a bargain waiting to close. That is exactly why valuation can't sit on the forecast axis: it describes condition, and condition points in different directions in different markets. Blend it into one “cycle” score and you answer two questions at once — where prices go next, and whether the market is expensive — and get both muddy. Kept apart, each instrument can be judged on its own terms. The Compass's four-cell ordering — Fuelled beating Starved — holds in the US, Malaysia and Japan; it breaks in Taiwan, but that's a sample problem, not a method one: 101 quarters of a nearly one-directional bull run means almost every “downtrend” quarter was simply followed by the next leg up. Momentum is also what finally reads Japan right — the one market that had a real crash to get right.
method.why_zh: 這樣拆開不是風格選擇，是資料逼出來的結果。把每一種力量單獨拿去對美國、台灣、馬來西亞、日本的三年前向房價報酬做檢驗，動能是唯一在所有市場都有效的一項：房價處於上升趨勢之後的季度，報酬比處於下降趨勢之後的季度高出七至十四個百分點，四個市場、無一例外。估值撐不過同一套檢驗——在有循環性的市場裡它照教科書均值回歸，但在日本反轉了十八點九個百分點，因為 1990 年後的便宜是結構性衰敗，不是等待兌現的划算。這正是估值不能放上預測軸的原因：它描述的是體質，而體質在不同市場指向不同方向。把它攪進一個「週期」分數，等於同時回答兩個問題——價格接下來往哪走、以及市場貴不貴——結果兩個都答得含糊。拆開來，每套儀器才能各自被檢驗。羅盤的四格排序——燃料格贏過飢餓格——在美國、馬來西亞、日本都成立；在台灣不成立，但這是樣本問題，不是方法問題：一百零一季幾乎單向的多頭，意味著「下降趨勢」的季度後面幾乎都接著下一段漲勢。也是動能，終於讓日本這個唯一真正崩盤過的市場被讀對。
method.frames_en: Three reference frames sit on this page, and each answers a different question. The compass is trailing and cyclical — momentum and credit impulse — and answers where prices are likely headed next. The self-history gauges are expanding, measuring valuation, population and supply against a market's own multi-decade record, and answer whether the market looks strained relative to its own past. The cross-country ranks are neither: they measure a market against the other 11 right now, and answer whether it's actually cheap or expensive in absolute terms. The US and Taiwan show why one frame alone misleads — the US reads expensive against its own history (z=-3.0) but only middling against the world (composite +0.30), while Taiwan reads neutral against its own history (z≈0) yet is the most expensive of the four against the world (composite -0.93, worst yield of all 12 markets). Use all three together, not one in isolation.
method.frames_zh: 這個頁面有三個參照座標，各自回答不同問題。羅盤是落後、順週期的——動能與信貸脈衝——回答「價格接下來可能往哪走」。健檢卡的自身歷史量表是擴張型的，把估值、人口與供給拿去對比該市場自己數十年的紀錄，回答「相對自己的過去，這個市場現在算不算緊繃」。跨國排名則兩者皆非：它把一個市場放進當下其他11個市場中比較，回答「就絕對水準而言，這個市場到底貴不貴」。美國與台灣正好說明只用單一座標會誤導：美國相對自身歷史顯得昂貴（z=-3.0），但相對世界卻只是中段（綜合分數+0.30）；台灣相對自身歷史持平（z≈0），但相對世界卻是這四個市場中最貴的一個（綜合分數-0.93，租金報酬率為全部12個市場中最差）。三者要合起來看，不能只取其一。

howto.compass_howto_en: The horizontal axis is momentum — the recent trend in house prices; the vertical axis is credit impulse — whether mortgage and household credit is accelerating or slowing. Crossing them gives four cells: Uptrend·Fuelled (prices rising, credit accelerating), Uptrend·Draining (prices rising but credit fading), Downtrend·Reflating (prices falling but credit turning up), and Downtrend·Starved (prices falling, credit still tightening). The glowing dot marks the latest quarter; a supply-glut warning lights up separately when vacancy or completions run loose relative to the recent norm (trailing z ≤ −1), since a glut can make even a fuelled uptrend risky.
howto.compass_howto_zh: 橫軸是動能——房價近期的趨勢；縱軸是信貸脈衝——房貸與家庭信貸正在加速還是放緩。兩軸交叉出四格：上升·助燃（房價漲、信貸加速）、上升·抽乾（房價漲但信貸轉弱）、下降·回溫（房價跌但信貸開始回升）、下降·斷糧（房價跌、信貸仍在收緊）。發光的點是最新一季；供給過剩警示會另外亮起——當空置率或完工量相對近期常態轉為寬鬆（滾動 z ≤ −1）時，即使是助燃中的上升格也可能變得危險。
howto.card_howto_en: Valuation, population growth and supply sit here as separate, transparent gauges — each one shows only whether that single force looks strained or comfortable right now. They are deliberately never averaged into one score and never used to predict where prices go next; that job belongs to the compass. Valuation and supply are standardised over the market's whole history, so they read position versus that market's own past — not a cross-country absolute (a market that is always expensive, like Taiwan near 9× income, reads mid-range against itself). Population instead reads an absolute growth direction on a fixed scale, not standardised against history — the same growth rate reads the same regardless of that market's own past.
howto.card_howto_zh: 估值、人口成長與供給在這裡各是一個獨立、透明的儀表——每一個只顯示該力量目前偏緊繃還是偏寬鬆，僅此而已。它們刻意不被平均成一個分數，也不用來預測房價接下來會怎麼走；那是羅盤的工作。估值與供給以該市場整段歷史標準化，讀的是相對該市場自身過去的位置——不是跨國絕對值（一個一直很貴的市場，如台灣約 9 倍所得，相對自己會落在中段）。人口則是固定尺度的絕對成長方向讀數，不是相對歷史標準化——不論該市場過去長什麼樣子，同樣的成長率讀數都一樣。
howto.fwd_note_en: In the US, Malaysia and Japan, the four compass cells order from best to worst forward three-year returns roughly as labelled — Fuelled beats Starved. Taiwan's history is too short and one-sided (about 101 quarters, almost all inside one bull run) for that ordering to hold — every "downtrend" quarter there was simply followed by the next leg up — so treat the forward numbers as a description of the past, not a promise. These are full-history medians; the ordering weakened after 2010 in the US and Japan — see the decade breakdown on the Framework page.
howto.fwd_note_zh: 在美國、馬來西亞與日本，羅盤四格的前向三年報酬大致依標籤排序由好到壞——助燃格贏過斷糧格。台灣的歷史太短、又幾乎單向（約 101 季，幾乎全落在同一段多頭），這個排序在那裡不成立——每一個「下降」的季度，後面接的都是下一段漲勢——因此前向數字請當作對過去的描述，不是承諾。以上為全歷史中位數，2010年後美國與日本的排序轉弱，詳見框架回測頁的十年分解表。
howto.xc_howto_en: This panel adds a third yardstick: instead of a market's own past, it ranks each market against the other 11 in the world right now — on PTI, rental yield, carry spread, vacancy and population growth — plus a combined valuation composite. Rank 1 means the most attractive reading of the 12; a market can look ordinary against its own history and still be cheap (or expensive) against the world, or the reverse.
howto.xc_howto_zh: 此面板加入第三個座標：不再只看一個市場相對自己過去的位置，而是把它放進當下的12個市場中排名——涵蓋房價所得比、租金報酬率、利差、空置率與人口成長，並合成一個估值綜合分數。第1名代表12個市場中最具吸引力的讀數；一個市場可能相對自身歷史普通，但相對世界卻便宜（或昂貴），反之亦然。
howto.risk_howto_en: A third instrument, kept separate from the compass and the report card: it answers one narrow, pre-registered question — is the market flashing the specific combination (no price momentum, credit still contracting, and a live supply glut) that has, historically, preceded either a 3-year nominal loss or a bottom-quartile outcome? The classification rule and the pass/fail bars were frozen before this test ran (scripts/compass_v3_protocol.md), and — unlike the compass's cell ordering — it passed. Pooled across the markets that qualify for each claim, the odds ratio comes out to {MH_ABS}× for an absolute loss and {MH_REL}× for a bottom-quartile outcome. Full detail and the failed-attempt history: /global/framework#v3compass.
howto.risk_howto_zh: 第三套儀器，與羅盤和體檢表分開設計：它只回答一個窄、且已預先凍結的問題——市場現在是否亮起那個特定組合（房價動能消失、信貸持續收縮、且供給過剩警示正在亮燈），而這個組合過去曾預示三年期名目虧損，或落入最差四分之一表現？分類規則與通過／失敗門檻，都在這次測試跑之前就已凍結（scripts/compass_v3_protocol.md），而且——與羅盤的四格排序不同——它通過了驗證。把符合資格的市場合併計算，絕對虧損的勝算比為{MH_ABS}倍，落入最差四分之一的勝算比為{MH_REL}倍。完整細節與失敗嘗試的紀錄：/global/framework#v3compass。
howto.risk_caveat_en: Important caveat: the absolute-loss validation above (US, Japan) rests on essentially two historical busts in this sample — the US 2006-08 crash and Japan's 1990s-2000s crash. The test was pre-registered and passed honestly, but the history behind it is thin. A third crash, whenever it comes, is the real out-of-sample test this page hasn't faced yet.
howto.risk_caveat_zh: 重要但書：以上絕對虧損驗證（美國、日本）基本上建立在樣本中僅有的兩次歷史崩盤之上——美國2006年至2008年的崩盤，以及日本1990年代至2000年代的崩盤。測試是預先凍結、誠實通過的，但背後的歷史樣本很薄。下一次崩盤，不論何時到來，才是這頁尚未面對過的真正樣本外測試。
